name: Progress-36
about: Progress-36 (1988-038A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1988 May 13. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1988 May 22), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
